svg.title: An audit log — SoftTrack web design mockup (#302)
svg.desc: A ticket keeps its own history and granting finance access writes a line to the server’s log, and beyond those two no page says who made somebody a site admin or who exported every ticket on a team. An append-only table records who, what, to what, when and from where, read by site admins, with finance events shown in full to finance admins only and a team’s events shown to its admins.
svg.text: · who did what, on a page
